articles.title: Kalshi election data goes live on DoubleZero ahead of U.S. midterms

articles.title: Prediction Markets Abandon Cheap Oil as Brent Passes $100

articles.title: US Police Fear Meta Glasses Are Watching Them Back: Report

articles.title: Polish Court Detains Fifth Suspect in Zondacrypto Exchange Probe

articles.title: Middle East Crypto Activity Triples to $350 Billion Amid Ongoing Conflict, Report Finds
articles.snippet: The Iran conflict has increased demand for digital assets to preserve and transfer wealth, while Gulf crypto businesses have kept operating through disruption, the Bitcoin Policy Institute says.
